final: WITH account_shares AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS share FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM account_shares) SELECT SUM(s.share * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order")) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - avg.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM account_shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS avg WHERE s.share > avg.avg_share
